targets.expr: count(kube_node_role{role="control-plane"})
1 - avg(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval]))

(sum(
  (kube_pod_container_status_running == 1) * on(pod, namespace, container, uid) group_right()
  (
    max_over_time(gpu:resource:requests{ node!=""}[$__interval])
  )
) or vector(0))

sum(gpu:resource:node{node!=""})

count(kube_node_info)
- count(count by (Hostname) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP / DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP))

sum(
  kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"true"}
  * on (node) group_left()
  kube_node_labels
 unless on (node)
  label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP, "node", "$1", "Hostname", "(.*)")
) or vector(0)

sum(
  kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown"}
  * on (node) group_left()
  kube_node_labels
   unless on (node)
  label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP, "node", "$1", "Hostname", "(.*)")
) or vector(0)
1 - sum(:node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes:sum{}) / sum(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{})
count(count by (Hostname) (DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP / DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP))

sum(
  kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"true"}
  * on (node) group_left()
  kube_node_labels
 and on (node)
  label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP, "node", "$1", "Hostname", "(.*)")
)

sum(
  kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status=~"false|unknown"}
  * on (node) group_left()
  kube_node_labels
 and on (node)
  label_replace(DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP, "node", "$1", "Hostname", "(.*)")
)
sum (max by (Hostname, UUID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE{}))

sum by (instance) (
  (1 - sum without (mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter", mode=~"idle|iowait|steal"}[$__rate_interval])))
/ ignoring(cpu) group_left
  count without (cpu, mode) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter", mode="idle"})
)

1 -
(
  avg by (instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"}) /
  avg by (instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"})
)

(
  (max by (instance) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", fstype!="", mountpoint="/etc/host"}) or max by (instance) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", fstype!="", mountpoint="/"}))
  -
  (max by (instance) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", fstype!="", mountpoint="/etc/host"}) or max by (instance) (node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter", fstype!="", mountpoint="/"}))
)
/
(max by (instance) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", fstype!="", mountpoint="/etc/host"}) or max by (instance) (node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter", fstype!="", mountpoint="/"}))
sum by (Hostname) (max by (Hostname, UUID) (DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE{}))

sum(rate(request_operation_total{node!=""}[$__range])) by (node)
or
avg by (node) (
label_replace(
   (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"}) * 0,
  "node", "$1", "instance", "(.*)"
))
